item.title: France reports first human case of Shamonda virus, but says there's no public health risk
item.description: France has reported the first-ever recorded case of a human contracting the Shamonda livestock virus, which is most commonly found in cattle. item.title: Pope Needs No Further Treatment for Lung Cancer, Doctors Say
item.description: Pope Leo needs no further treatment for lung cancer after follow-up tests confirmed the disease was localised, the Vatican said in a statement on Wednesday. Leo, 71, had the lower lobe of his right lung removed last week in the first major health event of his 17-month pontificate. The surgery confirmed he had adenocarcinoma, the most common type of lung cancer. He left the hospital on Saturday, four days after surgery and well ahead of the week-long hospital stay the Vatican had initially... item.title: NASA's CASALS instrument bridges gaps in 3D maps of Earth's surface
item.description: A team of researchers at NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center (GSFC) has developed a new instrument designed to eliminate blind spots between lines of lidar data on Earth's surface. Built with support from NASA's Earth Science Technology Office (ESTO), the Concurrent Artificially-intelligent Spectrometry Lidar System (CASALS) could help researchers map the features of Earth's surface in detail. Rather than mechanically steering a laser with moving mirrors, CASALS steers light using wavelength itself, generating a continuous, 3D swath of the ground below. Publicado también por: NASA. Fuente: Phys.org.
